title: XTI Aerospace Schedules Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Webcast

body_markdown:
FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla., Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — XTI Aerospace, Inc. (Nasdaq: XTIA) (“XTI Aerospace,” “XTI,” or the “Company”), parent company of Drone Nerds, LLC, (“Drone Nerds”), a leading drone solutions platform serving commercial, enterprise and government customers, today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on November 12, 2026, after the market closes.


In conjunction with the earnings release, management will host a conference call and webcast on November 12, 2026, at 4:30 PM ET, including a question and answer session with Jeremy Schneiderman, Interim Chief Executive Officer and Brooke Turk, Chief Financial Officer.


During the webcast, management will review the Company’s third quarter 2026 financial results and provide updates on the continued execution of XTI’s strategic transformation, including operational progress, key cost reduction initiatives, commercial activity across its core businesses and progress toward positive average monthly cash flow.


To participate in the call, please register in advance using this link:[https://xti-aerospace-3q-2026-conference-call.open-exchange.net/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4817208-1&h=4001198046&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnam09.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fxti-aerospace-3q-2026-conference-call.open-exchange.net%252F%26data%3D05%257C02%257Calison.ziegler%2540xtiaerospace.com%257C2a5fa581c80b4004252508df3c443139%257Cce4f55b4316a4a23a1ee80852066d407%257C0%257C0%257C639295935754843939%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3D%252F9mHtlLJzH98hWEkOjOwIcfxe6j4anRYmZuTJxImbJ4%253D%26reserved%3D0&a=https%3A%2F%2Fxti-aerospace-3q-2026-conference-call.open-exchange.net%2F) . The registration link is also available on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website under “IR News & Events.” Dial-in information will be provided upon registration.


A replay of the event will be available in the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website under “IR News & Events” following the conclusion of the call and will remain available for at least 30 days.


**About XTI Aerospace, Inc.** XTI Aerospace, Inc. (“XTI”) (Nasdaq: XTIA) is focused on building a leading platform for commercial and government drone adoption in the growing unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”) industry. Through its subsidiary, Drone Nerds, LLC, XTI supports enterprise and government customers in sectors including public safety, agriculture, construction, and energy across the drone program lifecycle, from hardware sourcing and deployment to training, service, repair, and the proprietary Always Flying™ program. Its established U.S. customer base and reputation as a trusted solutions provider position the company as a go-to-market partner for drone manufacturers and software developers seeking to scale in the domestic market.
